title: Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak discovery could open the door to a world of mods
summary: An obscure game has provided an unlikely route into Nintendo's latest console.
body: Credit: Pepsipu.com TL;DR A developer has released a software-only Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak that works on the latest firmware. The exploit uses vulnerabilities involving SmileBASIC 4 and has already been demonstrated with Mario Kart World mods. The jailbreak isn’t permanent and doesn’t yet provide full control over the console. Unsurprisingly, Nintendo hasn’t exactly made life easy for anyone hoping to tinker with the Switch 2 beyond its intended limits. But one developer has now made a significant breakthrough, releasing a software-only Switch 2 jailbreak that works even on the console’s latest firmware. Security researcher Sammy Hajhamid, who goes by pepsipu online, announced the achievement on X and explained how it works in a detailed blog post . The exploit, called ns2jb, works on firmware version 23.0.1 without requiring any physical modifications to the console. There are caveats, but the jailbreak may open the door to things like unofficial software and game modifications.

title: 1Password’s new solution mitigates the security risks of AI agent account access
summary: 1Password just made giving your AI agent account access a little safer.
body: Credit: 1Password TL;DR 1Password has created a way for AI agents to use your passwords without actually seeing them. When an agent reaches a login screen, 1Password for Agents will autofill the password or one-time code so the agent can’t see or take possession of your credentials. It will work with a range of AI agents, such as Muse and Grok, with more to come later. You may trust an AI agent to help with your work, but you probably draw the line at letting it access your passwords. While understandable, that choice can also act as an obstacle when an AI agent needs access to an account. 1Password aims to solve the security risks of AI agent account access with its new solution. The digital vault and password manager company has announced 1Password for Agents. This new platform is designed to let AI agents use your passwords without letting the agent actually see or take possession of them. You’ll be able to connect it with Facebook’s Muse and SpaceX Super Intelligence’s Grok bot. More agent connections are expected to be on the way, including Claude Duet, ChatGPT Work and dots, Perplexity, and more.

body: TL;DR Google Search’s AI Mode no longer offers the direct “Export to Docs” shortcut in its three-dot menu. Gemini and NotebookLM still offer Docs export options, but Google hasn’t explained whether AI Mode’s shortcut will return. Imagine researching a complicated topic with Google Search AI Mode , gathering explanations and useful information, then saving everything to Google Docs for later. Until recently, that last step took just a couple of taps. But Google appears to have quietly removed the shortcut from Search, frustrating users who relied on it to turn their searches into editable documents. Several users have reported that the “Export to Docs” option has disappeared from the three-dot menu in Google Search AI Mode. We’ve confirmed the change on both desktop and mobile, where the menu now shows only one option: “About this response.” Similar complaints have also surfaced on Reddit .
